changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Attribute_Retired') BEGIN DROP TABLE dbo.Attribute_Retired END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Attribute_Retired') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Attribute_Retired]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ParentID] [int] NULL, [AttributeTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [ObjectType] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [InheritanceObjectType] [varchar](50) NULL, [InheritanceObjectID] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [DisplayValue] AS ([utility].[GetObjectDisplayValueWrapper]('Attribute',[ID],[AttributeTypeID])), CONSTRAINT [PK_Attribute] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Attribute_ParentAttribute') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Attribute_Retired] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Attribute_ParentAttribute] FOREIGN KEY([ParentID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Attribute_Retired] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Attribute_Retired] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Attribute_ParentAttribute] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Attribute_ObjectType-ObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Attribute_ObjectType-ObjectID] ON [dbo].[Attribute_Retired] ( [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END
